publication.title: New thyreophoran remains with stegosaurian affinities from the Lower Cretaceous of Argentina
publication.journal: Publicación Electrónica de la Asociación Paleontológica Argentina
authors: J. I. Canale, P. A. Gallina

locality.name: PBDB collection 219496: The remains were found in outcrops of the Bajada Colorada Formation (Neuquén Basin), at its type locality 40 km south of Picún Leufú town on the national route 237, in southeastern Neuquén Province, Patagonia, Argentina

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 219496 to Late Berriasian–Valanginian with numeric bounds 139.1–132.6 Ma.
